heading: What the Texas Board of Nursing says about your Texas license

items.label: Compact state
items.text: The Texas Board of Nursing states:
items.quote: Texas remains a compact state, affording Texas nurses the ability to respond to the challenges of modern health care, and provide borderless nursing services in other eNLC states.

items.label: Verification requests
items.text: On its Compact with Texans page, the board states:
items.quote: Licensure verification requests are answered within 10 working days.
